title: UAAP: Why Kieffer Alas missed Ateneo’s do-or-die bout against UST
summary: Ateneo de Manila University fell short in its do-or-die clash against University of Santo Tomas in UAAP Season 89 on Sunday, with star rookie Kieffer Alas sidelined for the crucial contest.
